expected_structural_delta: No new production modules, roots, state owners, protocols, or public operations. Extend two existing shell owners and add one focused test file.
minimum_design: Replace the predictable rollover temporary name with checked mktemp under RUNDIR, check GitHub validation temporary-directory creation, and terminate Docker options before the image argument while retaining existing cleanup.
outcome: When rollover or GitHub validation needs temporary state, it uses a checked runtime-scoped temporary path. When a remote image reaches host docker pull, the image value cannot become a Docker option.

reuse_decisions.name: RUNDIR temporary-state boundary
reuse_decisions.rationale: The existing engine already owns rollover and validation temporary state. Runtime-scoped mktemp keeps cleanup and ownership at that boundary.

reuse_decisions.name: Docker host-pull wrapper
reuse_decisions.rationale: The existing host_docker_pull function is the single host-side pull owner, so its argv contract is the narrow option-boundary fix.

reuse_decisions.name: tests/temp-safety.sh
reuse_decisions.rationale: A focused fixture is needed to force mktemp failure and inspect the image argument boundary.
